label: Agno
description: The workflow becomes an Agno flow: an async function for each block, Agno Agents (OpenAILike models, tools, output_schema for typed answers) for the AI blocks, and a FLOW that AgentCanvas's flow engine runs as the canvas draws it. Any catalog model works, and tool calls can wait for a person's confirmation (Agno's requires_confirmation). Runs need Agno installed on the server (`make framework FW=agno`); designing and exporting do not. No saved history, state editing or breakpoints; a paused run lives in memory.

notes.core.set: an async function that returns the fields it sets
notes.core.router: the flow engine follows the first route whose CEL rule matches (generated orchestration: Agno has no graph of its own)
notes.core.join: the flow engine waits for every branch before the block runs
notes.core.approval: the run pauses and is saved as JSON; it continues from that step when a person answers
notes.core.human_input: the run pauses and asks again when an answer does not fit
notes.core.script: your workspace function is called from the flow
notes.knowledge.search: the flow searches the knowledge base; exports search its file with the built-in embedder
notes.core.llm: an Agno Agent with the block's model, asked once with agent.arun
notes.core.agent: an Agno Agent (instructions, model, tools, output_schema); tools named in 'Ask before using' use @tool(requires_confirmation=True): the run pauses, its RunOutput is saved, and acontinue_run goes on once a person confirms, edits or rejects each call
notes.mw.model_call_limit: the runtime counts the agent's model calls in one turn (Agno's own tool_call_limit counts tool calls): past the limit the agent stops with a note, or the run fails when the block says so
